description: Prepare an unsigned Hyperliquid BTC/ETH/HYPE perpetual IOC order envelope for local wallet signing. Use it when an agent has decided on market, side, size and limit price and needs reviewed lot/tick, impact and mark-oracle checks. Do not use it to create a nonce, sign, or submit an order. Returns the short-expiry unsigned exchange envelope and the validated bounds when every gate passes.
